name: Kreldig Ungor
summary: At Nijel's Point, Kreldig Ungor directs Reclaimers Inc.'s work in dangerous Desolace. He hires Alliance adventurers to recover lost cargo and gather local reagents.

sections.title: Field Agent in the Wastes
sections.body: Kreldig works from Nijel's Point, an Alliance refuge among Desolace's blighted canyons. He represents Reclaimers Inc., far from Khaz Modan, where centaur clans, demons, and the Horde contest the wilderness. Others see ruin and ash. Kreldig sees lost goods and assets that can still be reclaimed for profit.

sections.title: The Karnitol Contract
sections.body: Kreldig seeks the lost vessel of Karnitol, wrecked along Desolace's treacherous western coast. Its shipment held prized goods. He directs the search for the wreck and the scattered cargo, before scavengers or coastal sea giants claim it.

sections.title: Harvesting Local Reagents
sections.body: Kreldig also oversees the gathering of Desolace's unusual biological and mineral resources for Reclaimers Inc. The harsh land breeds distinctive fauna and flora, whose parts bring high prices from alchemists and engineers in the Eastern Kingdoms. Adventurers who face the wasteland's predators can earn steady pay through his contracts.

faq.answer: Kreldig Ungor works for Reclaimers Inc. from Nijel's Point, the Alliance outpost in Desolace. He coordinates salvage and specimen gathering across the zone.
Reclaimers Inc. seeks profit by salvaging lost cargo, recovering wreckage, and gathering rare reagents in dangerous frontiers.

faq.q: Where can Kreldig Ungor be found?
faq.answer: Kreldig works at Nijel's Point, high in the rocky mountains of northeastern Desolace.

faq.q: What does Kreldig want with the Karnitol shipwreck?
faq.answer: A vessel carrying Karnitol's valuable goods wrecked along the Desolace coast. Kreldig hires adventurers to find the wreck and recover its cargo before scavengers claim it or it is destroyed.

faq.q: Why is Kreldig collecting reagents in Desolace?
faq.answer: Desolace's harsh conditions foster rare creatures and unusual natural compounds. Kreldig gathers specimens for alchemists, artificers, and buyers in major Alliance cities.

faq.q: Does Kreldig work for Ironforge or a private enterprise?
faq.answer: Kreldig represents Reclaimers Inc., a commercial enterprise pursuing salvage and trade. Though based at an Alliance outpost, he hires Alliance wanderers for the company's work, not official royal military aims.

angles.text: Kreldig carries a dwarven taste for rugged frontier exploration and commercial ambition. He works far from the mountain halls.
At Nijel's Point, Kreldig relies on Alliance travelers to carry out his salvage contracts in hostile territory.
